slides.title: Thanksgiving week at a small trucking company.

slides.label: The owner
slides.title: At his in-laws'. Phone on silent.
slides.body: "Only call if a truck is on fire."

slides.label: The drivers
slides.title: Home for once.
slides.body: Eating pie. Not answering texts about paperwork.

slides.label: Me
slides.title: Checking whose med card expires in December.
slides.body: Plus two truck registrations, the insurance renewal and a permit nobody remembers applying for.

slides.label: Save this
slides.title: Someone's gotta hold it down.
slides.body: If that someone is you: write down every December expiration before the long weekend, not after.
